algorithm.input: production L1 final SweepLedger units and retained production WeSpeaker vectors
algorithm.canonical_references: per-L1-canonical duration-weighted mean of up to 10 longest admitted retained vectors; fall back to all retained vectors
algorithm.cluster_mapping: duration-weighted centroid to canonical references, global one-to-one linear assignment, then score and margin gates
algorithm.rewrite: rank changed units by descending proposed-minus-incumbent cosine score; preserve one-to-one labels within each span; enforce meeting duration budget

development_grid.selection: maximize duration-weighted development speaker accuracy subject to every non-gain gate; deterministic ties choose smaller rewrite budget, then higher score, then higher margin
development_grid.validation_access: selected configuration only, exactly once after selection

target_error_subset.definition: all cases in each frozen split; no post-result case selection
target_error_subset.score: duration-weighted speaker accuracy over complete reference speaker seconds

preconditions_before_scoring.full_chain_audit: evaluator to candidate input boundary; candidate sees runtime manifest and decision objects only
preconditions_before_scoring.label_perturbation: change evaluation truth labels A,B to A,A; runtime shape and complete decision semantic hash must remain identical
